description:
PlantHealth, coordinated at the Universitat Politècnica de València, trains specialists in sustainable plant-health and cropping systems. The First Call for the next intake runs from 1 October to 31 December 2026 and is the round in which Erasmus Mundus scholarships are awarded; a second call in late May 2027 serves self-funded students only.

Programme Highlights

  • Two-call structure: scholarship round ends 31 December 2026, self-funded round in May-June 2027
  • UPV-coordinated programme with European mobility and industry contact
  • Scholarship package around EUR 1,400 monthly plus tuition coverage
  • Careers in crop protection, plant-health regulation and agri-food R&D

Who Should Apply

Agronomy, biology, plant science and environmental graduates are the typical applicants, with English documentation per the UPV checklist.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarship (approx. EUR 1,400/month) for selected First Call applicants; tuition covered.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply through the UPV online pre-enrolment before 31 December 2026 for scholarship consideration. Key deadline information: 31 December 2026 (First Call, EMJM scholarship round; window 1 October – 31 December 2026). Second call 20 May – 15 June 2027 (self-funded only).
